title: Senate prepares possible war-powers vote as Iran war enters midterm debate
summary: U.S. Senate leaders were considering a nonbinding war-powers vote as Democrats sought to put senators on record over the Iran conflict ahead of the November midterm elections; some Republicans have differed with President Trump on the issue.

title: Political committees increase coordinated spending ahead of U.S. midterms
summary: Reuters reported that Republican and Democratic campaign committees have increased coordinated spending after a June Supreme Court ruling removed federal caps that had limited such spending.

title: White House pushes accelerated review of voter rolls before midterms
summary: Reuters reported that federal agencies are reviewing voter rolls from at least 47 states as the White House pushes an accelerated effort to identify possible noncitizen registrations; the administration says the initiative is aimed at election integrity.

title: Missouri congressional map dispute remains before Supreme Court
summary: An appeals court backed Missouri's Republican-drawn congressional map but paused its ruling until September 28 while the Supreme Court has time to respond. Missouri officials are using the prior map for now.

title: Reuters/Ipsos poll measures Trump approval at 32%
summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll of 1,277 U.S. adults measured President Donald Trump's approval at 32%. Among registered voters asked about congressional preference, 43% chose Democratic candidates and 35% Republican candidates; the poll's margin of error was 3 percentage points.

title: NASA selects PRIMA as first mission in a new far-infrared telescope class
summary: NASA announced that PRIMA, a far-infrared space telescope concept, is advancing to the next phase of development to study the history and evolution of the universe.

title: Hubble reaches 200,000 orbits around Earth
summary: NASA reported that the Hubble Space Telescope completed its 200,000th orbit on September 19 while continuing observations of distant astronomical objects.

title: NASA reports 2026 Arctic sea-ice minimum
summary: NASA and the National Snow and Ice Data Center reported that Arctic sea ice reached its 2026 annual minimum on September 12, covering an estimated 4.6 million square kilometers.

title: UN chief calls for global safeguards and oversight for AI
summary: In his final UN General Assembly address, Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for international cooperation on AI safety testing, evaluation and a multilateral risk-management framework.

title: Grok 4.7 is introduced for coding and knowledge work
summary: xAI introduced Grok 4.7 with a larger base model, longer reinforcement-learning training on difficult tasks and an emphasis on checking work more carefully.

title: Saudi Arabia unveils CEER EXOBOT electric sedan and SUV
summary: Saudi automotive brand CEER revealed an electric sedan and SUV under the EXOBOT name.

title: CERN begins disconnecting the LHC for the High-Luminosity upgrade
summary: CERN has begun disconnecting and dismantling focusing magnets around ATLAS and CMS as part of the third long shutdown.
